## NEVER DO

- **NEVER** commit or push directly to `main`. `main` tracks upstream OTel — always work on a feature/fix branch.
- **NEVER** force push (`git push --force`). If absolutely required, use `--force-with-lease`.
- **NEVER** make requests to, curl, query, or interact with production endpoints: `int.meesho.int`, `prd.meesho.int`, `int.mrouter.int`, `prd.mrouter.int`.
- **NEVER** introduce backward-incompatible changes to public APIs, request/response schemas, config keys, or exported metric names/labels without explicit user approval. Dashboards, alerts, and stored series depend on current behavior.
- **NEVER** hand-edit generated files: `*_bpfel.go`, `*_bpfeb.go`, `*_bpfel.o`, `*_bpfeb.o`, `bpf/bpfcore/`. Change the `.c` source and regenerate.
- **NEVER** modify a `.c` file under `bpf/` without running `make docker-generate` in the same change. The generated `.o` is committed; CI fails on `check-clean-work-tree` if it drifts. Use the Docker target, not bare `make generate` — the pinned generator image is what CI compares against.
- **NEVER** add or rename a field in `obi.Config` without running `make generate-config-schema`. The JSON schema and the configuration reference doc are committed and gated by `make check-config-schema`.
- **NEVER** add a metric feature by branching on raw config. Add a bit to `export.Features` and a name to `FeatureMapper` (`pkg/export/feature.go`) — every exporter gates on the bitmask.
- **NEVER** introduce an unbounded buffer, map, or label set in the export path. Every aggregation here is explicitly capped with an overflow counter; an uncapped one is a memory leak on a host agent that never restarts.
- **NEVER** mutate queue routing (`Subscribe`, `Bypass`) after the pipeline has started. Both are wire-up-time only so `Send` stays lock-free.
- **NEVER** use a kernel helper or eBPF feature newer than the minimum supported kernel (5.8 + BTF; 4.18 for RHEL8-family) unless gated by a runtime check.
- **NEVER** land opportunistic or drive-by refactoring. `CONTRIBUTING.md:141` — refactors must be directly relevant to the change.
- **NEVER** submit AI-generated PR/issue text unreviewed. `AI-POLICY.md` §3 makes this a rejection criterion, and §5 requires declaring non-trivial Generative AI use.

## Architecture

A single privileged Go agent that attaches eBPF programs to already-running processes and
exports OTel traces/metrics. Optimized for low kernel overhead and bounded userspace memory,
traded against generality: optional pipeline stages are **wired out** at construction time
(`swarm.Bypass`) rather than branched around at runtime, and every userspace buffer carries
an explicit cap plus an overflow counter.

Three independent pipelines run under one `errgroup` — application (discovery → attach →
decorate → export), network flows, and TCP stats. Only the application pipeline goes through
discovery. Stage ordering is authoritative in
[`devdocs/pipeline-map.md`](devdocs/pipeline-map.md).

## Fork context

This repo is a fork of upstream `open-telemetry/opentelemetry-ebpf-instrumentation`. `main`
tracks upstream; Meesho patches live on feature branches and must stay rebaseable.

- Mark every local change with a `Meesho fork patch` comment so rebase conflicts are attributable.
- Keep local patches additive and file-local where possible — new files (`pkg/export/otel/api_dependency.go`) rebase cleanly; edits scattered through upstream hot paths do not.
- When touching `bpf/generictracer/` or `bpf/gotracer/`, expect the committed `.o` blobs to conflict on every rebase. Resolve by regenerating (`make docker-generate`), never by hand-merging binary artifacts.

Current local patches are listed in [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md#fork-context).

## Testing

- Unit tests are plain `testing.T` with `stretchr/testify` assertions; `make test` runs `go test -short -race` across all packages and needs `KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS` from `setup-envtest` (wired by the target).
- For iteration, scope it: `go test -short ./pkg/export/otel/...`.
- Integration tests are Docker Compose driven and live in `internal/test/integration/`: `go test -v -run <TestName> -timeout 10m ./internal/test/integration/`.
- `make compile` cross-compiles to **Linux** by default (`GOOS ?= linux`) even on macOS — so a green `make compile` on a Mac says nothing about whether the eBPF loaders actually attach. Verify loader changes on Linux or in the VM targets.

## Quick reference

| Task | Command | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full validation | `make verify` | `prereqs go-mod-tidy lint test license-header-check` |
| Build (generate + verify + compile) | `make build` | Requires Docker |
| Compile binary only | `make compile` | → `bin/obi`; cross-compiles to `GOOS=linux` by default |
| Unit tests | `make test` | `-short -race`, all packages, with coverage |
| Scoped tests | `go test -short ./pkg/<pkg>/...` | Fast iteration loop |
| Integration tests | `go test -v -run <Name> -timeout 10m ./internal/test/integration/` | Docker Compose |
| Lint (Go) | `make lint` / `make lint-fix` | `golangci-lint` via `go tool`; no global install needed |
| Lint (Markdown) | `make lint-markdown` | Runs in Docker |
| Regenerate eBPF bindings | `make docker-generate` | **Required** after any `bpf/**/*.c` edit |
| Regenerate config schema + docs | `make generate-config-schema` | **Required** after any `obi.Config` change |
| Check schema is current | `make check-config-schema` | What CI runs |
| Format / lint C | `make clang-format` / `make clang-tidy` | Needs a local `clang-format` / `clang-tidy-19` binary |
| Install pre-commit hooks | `make install-hooks` | Enforces C formatting automatically |
